nodes.name: description_label
nodes.text:
Runs up to nine enchantment operations in parallel. Put target items in the main grid and Enchantability Modules in the three orange slots; completed items remain in their grid slots. The alternate mode can extract enchantments into Books or absorb all enchantments as XP fluid. Refined Aetherium Crystal is used as the extraction catalyst.

Item I/O:
§9Main Grid§r inserts targets and can extract their processed versions.
§bModule Input§r fills the orange module slots.
§1Disenchant Source§r inserts or extracts the alternate-mode source.
§bCatalyst Input§r supplies Refined Aetherium Crystal.
§9Book Input§r supplies normal Books.
§3Input All§r exposes every item input.
§cProcessed Grid§r, §cProcessed Source§r, and §4Enchanted Books§r expose their respective results.
§cOutput All§r exposes every item result.

Liquid I/O:
§9XP Input§r supplies enchanting operations.
§cXP Output§r drains XP recovered by absorption.
§9Input §r+ §cOutput§r allows both on one face.
